AI Cleaner needs a few permissions to scan your storage and keep you informed. Here is exactly what each permission does and why it\'s needed.
Why: To scan your gallery for duplicate, blurry, and cloud-backed photos that can be safely deleted to free up space.
What we will NOT do: Read the content of your photos, upload them, or share them with anyone.
Why: To find large video files and offer compression so you keep your memories at a fraction of the storage cost.
What we will NOT do: Modify, upload, or share your videos. We only read file sizes and names.
Why: To alert you when your storage drops critically low, so you can free space before running out.
What we will NOT do: Spam you. We send at most one alert per day and only when storage is genuinely low.
🔒 Your privacy is our priority. All analysis happens entirely on your device. No files are ever uploaded to any server.
You can grant permissions later from Settings → App Permissions.
